description.value: Bahar Bakery & Cafe is an artisanal bakery and espresso bar on downtown Vancouver's Robson Street, founded as a heartfelt tribute to Bahareh Karami Moghadam, a victim of PS752. The cafe serves an extensive lineup of handcrafted Persian and Western pastries, whole custom cakes, sandwiches, and specialty coffee drinks in a warm, community-focused setting. Catering and event services are also available for larger occasions.
